verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation is a fair question for an agentic commerce platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only webhook events, such as `checkout.session.completed`, SPT state-transition events and catalog-import status events, which a developer would have to build on. Nothing documents a user-facing way to define rules that automatically trigger actions on those events. Webhooks alone are developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
